crosswalk.physical_interpretation: use a prior authorization without re-observing policy-relevant physical state
age-bounded reuse may still miss state change inside the permitted window
re-observe measured actuator position and rain state immediately before dispatch

physical_only_failure_modes: measurement can be stale even when a verdict is young
measured state can contradict the state used by authorization
hardware identity can remain stable while state validity changes
nonclaims: not an implementation of Freshness-Bounded Shield
not evidence that HALO adopts AirTrajectory semantics
not a claim that physical re-observation eliminates all authorization-execution gaps
